images.prompt: Premium editorial illustration, high-end tech magazine style: a grand theater stage where a shiny robotic showpiece performs under a spotlight for an applauding audience of executives — while backstage, half in shadow, a small sturdy robot quietly tends a wall of humming network racks, holding a pager that glows softly. The show up front, the work in back. Deep dark navy (#161a45) dominant palette, soft cream (#F4EFE3) highlights, thin red (#eb2027) accent on the glowing pager only — no green, no purple, no rainbow palettes. No readable text, letters, or numbers anywhere. Cinematic moody lighting, minimalist composition.
